who.heading: Coaching for the hardest step in a career: becoming a manager.
who.description: Edstellar's first-time manager coaching is built for the people making their first move into managing others, and for those facing the sharpest version of that transition.

panels.title: Newly promoted managers
panels.description: Your strongest individual contributor is now responsible for others. Coaching helps them make the shift in identity and approach before early missteps become patterns.
panels.tracks_label: Tracks newly promoted managers often choose:

panels.title: Managers leading former peers
panels.description: The most uncomfortable version of the transition: managing the people you sat next to yesterday. Coaching builds the authority and boundaries the relationship needs.
panels.tracks_label: Tracks managers of former peers often choose:

panels.title: New managers hired from outside
panels.description: Landing in a new organization and a new management role at the same time. Coaching helps new managers read the culture, earn trust fast and establish credibility.
panels.tracks_label: Tracks externally hired managers often choose:

panels.title: Managers in their first 90 days
panels.description: The window when first impressions form, authority is established and the team decides whether to follow. Coaching makes the most of the time that matters most.
panels.tracks_label: Tracks managers in the first 90 days often choose:

tracks.heading: Six Edstellar first-time manager coaching tracks on Meridian.
tracks.description: Each new manager chooses one track with their coach in the chemistry session. It shapes the objective, the coach's preparation on Meridian and every session that follows.

process.heading: How an Edstellar first-time manager coaching program runs.
process.description: Six steps take each new manager from nomination to a final summary they control, over six to eight months. Your CHRO sees progress at every step; the coaching itself stays between manager and coach.

steps.label: Nominate new managers
steps.title: Nominate new managers
steps.description: Your CHRO or program admin adds each manager on Meridian with their role, the transition they are making and their focus areas. The manager agrees to take part.

steps.label: Match a coach
steps.title: Match a coach
steps.description: In a 30-minute video session, the manager reviews the certified coaches Meridian recommends and chooses one. The CHRO can join this session if the manager wants them there.

steps.label: Chemistry session
steps.title: Chemistry session
steps.description: A free 30-minute session to test the fit, confirm the objective, choose one of the six manager tracks and agree the schedule.
steps.who: Manager and coach · live on video

steps.label: Coaching sessions
steps.title: Coaching sessions
steps.description: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching on Meridian. The manager sets the focus, the coach prepares, and an assignment carries the work forward.
steps.who: Manager and coach · live on video

steps.label: Mid-point check-in
steps.title: Mid-point check-in
steps.description: Halfway through, manager and coach review progress against the objective and adjust the plan for the hours ahead.
steps.who: Manager and coach · live on video

steps.label: Final review and summary
steps.title: Final review and summary
steps.description: The final session agrees what the manager will keep doing, and the manager chooses what the CHRO sees in the final summary.

process_cta.heading: See Meridian with your own new managers.
process_cta.description: A 30-minute walkthrough of coach matching, the session room and the view your CHRO sees, set up around your managers.

confidential.heading: Confidential first-time manager coaching, by design on Meridian.
confidential.description: The coaching stays private. Your organization still sees that the engagement is on track. Switch views to compare the same Meridian screen.

points.title: Private to manager and coach
points.text: Session notes, assignments, the coach’s preparation and the manager’s reflections.

points.title: Visible to your CHRO
points.text: Objective, track, hours used, progress, check-ins and the final summary the manager chooses to share.

points.title: Where the CHRO can join
points.text: Only the coach matching session, and only if the manager wants them there.

rows.label: Objective
rows.value: Lead my former peers with confidence and fairness

rows.label: Session notes
rows.value: Postponing feedback to a former peer; name the standard.

rows.label: Assignment
rows.value: Hold the feedback conversation by Friday.

rows.label: Coach’s preparation
rows.value: Questions on fairness and how the team sees it.

rows.label: Reflections
rows.value: Easier than expected once it was said plainly.

rows.label: Final summary
rows.value: Shared at the end, in the manager’s own words

items.question: What is first-time manager coaching?
items.answer: First-time manager coaching is one-on-one professional coaching for people making their first move into managing others, focused on the identity shift, practical skills and confidence the transition demands. Edstellar's program pairs each new manager with a certified coach for ten to twelve hours over six to eight months, run on Meridian.

items.question: Who is first-time manager coaching for?
items.answer: First-time manager coaching is for newly promoted managers, managers leading former peers, new managers hired from outside the organization and any manager in their first 90 days in a people management role.

items.question: How long does a first-time manager coaching engagement last?
items.answer: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching over six to eight months. The session length and schedule are agreed in the free chemistry session.

items.question: What certifications do Edstellar coaches hold?
items.answer: Every Edstellar coach is certified by the International Coaching Federation (ICF) at PCC or MCC level, the International Coaching Community (ICC) or the European Mentoring and Coaching Council (EMCC). Coaches are also vetted by Edstellar before Meridian can recommend them.

items.question: How does Edstellar match a new manager with a coach?
items.answer: Meridian recommends certified coaches based on the manager's track, objective, language and time zone. In a 30-minute video session the manager reviews the recommendations and chooses one, then meets the coach in a free chemistry session before anyone commits.

items.question: What does our organization see during first-time manager coaching?
items.answer: Your CHRO sees sessions held, hours used, progress against the agreed objective and the parts of the final summary the manager chooses to share. Session content, notes and assignments stay between manager and coach.

items.question: What are the six first-time manager coaching tracks?
items.answer: From Peer to Manager, Managing Former Colleagues, The First 90 Days, Feedback & Accountability, Delegation & Letting Go and Managing Upwards. The manager chooses one with the coach in the chemistry session.

items.question: Is first-time manager coaching delivered virtually?
items.answer: Yes. Edstellar delivers first-time manager coaching virtually on Meridian, with every session on video and managers seeing times in their own time zone. Language and time zone are part of how coaches are matched.
